now.title: X-Men '97
now.text: In episode 14, Bishop rescues Xavier from ancient Egypt.

changes.evidence: Rise of Apocalypse Part II (X-Men '97 ep 14) is set in Ancient Egypt in 3000 B.C.; Bishop rescues Xavier there after Apocalypse kills Magneto. The record names ancient Egypt but shows no place.

now.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
now.text: In episode 9, the mercenary Cable helps Gambit escape Genosha, then hunts Apocalypse's agent on Muir Island.

changes.evidence: The Cure (ep 9): Cable learns Adler has moved to Muir Island and attacks 'Dr. Adler' (Mystique, Apocalypse's ally) at the Muir Island research center. The record names Muir Island but shows no place.

now.title: X-Men '97
now.text: In episode 17, living with the Acolytes in the Savage Land, he judges Graydon Creed, then returns to the school.

changes.evidence: Strange Land, Savage Heart (X-Men '97 ep 17): the trial of Graydon Creed with Colossus as judge happens at the Acolytes' Savage Land base in Antarctica. The record names the Savage Land but shows no place.

now.title: X-Men '97
now.text: In season 2, back home, Scott fights Danger on Genosha, and Rogue frees him from Apocalypse's control.

changes.evidence: Danger.exe (ep 16): Danger battles Xavier and the X-Men in the ruins of Genosha; Survival of the Fittest (ep 19): X-Force and X-Factor attack X-Corp (based at Genosha since ep 16) and Rogue frees everyone from Apocalypse. The record names Genosha but shows no place.

now.title: X-Men '97
now.text: In episode 5, Gambit dies destroying Master Mold to save Genosha.

changes.evidence: Remember It (X-Men '97 ep 5): the Sentinels attack Genosha during its UN gala and Gambit sacrifices himself to destroy the Master Mold there. The record names Genosha but shows no place.

now.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
now.text: In episode 17, Jubilee is lured to the Friends of Humanity, then helps Colossus and Wolverine fight Omega Red in Russia.

changes.evidence: Red Dawn (ep 17): Marvel Database lists Moscow (Red Square) as the Russian location where Jubilee, Wolverine and Colossus fight Omega Red; Colossus's record for the same event already shows Moscow. The record says Russia but shows no place.

now.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
now.text: In season 2, powerless in the Savage Land, Magneto works with Xavier to escape Mister Sinister, then parts as his enemy.

changes.evidence: Whatever It Takes / Reunion (eps 16-26): powerless Xavier and Magneto are in the Savage Land, where Sinister is defeated and Magneto parts as Xavier's enemy. The record names the Savage Land but shows no place.

now.title: X-Men '97
now.text: In episode 10, having plunged Earth into a blackout, Magneto makes his stand on Asteroid M, then vanishes in time when the asteroid explodes.

changes.evidence: Tolerance Is Extinction Part 2-3 (eps 9-10): Magneto re-establishes his haven on Asteroid M, fights the Blue Team there, and the asteroid explodes in space. The record names Asteroid M but shows no place.

now.title: X-Men '97
now.text: In episode 14, stranded in ancient Egypt, he saves a city from a black hole before Apocalypse kills him.

changes.evidence: Rise of Apocalypse Part II (ep 14) is set in Ancient Egypt in 3000 B.C.; Magneto stops the black hole over the pharaoh's city and Apocalypse kills him there. The record names ancient Egypt but shows no place.

now.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
now.text: In episode 9, at her Muir Island research center, Moira tells Xavier she cannot review Dr. Adler's mutant cure.

changes.evidence: The Cure (ep 9): 'At the Muir Island Research Center, Professor Xavier asks Moira MacTaggert to review Dr. Adler's work, but Moira says she can not.' The record names Muir Island but shows no place.

now.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
now.text: In episode 31, Moira is caring for Xavier on Muir Island when Juggernaut and Black Tom attack it to seize Lilandra.

changes.evidence: Phoenix Saga Part III (ep 31): Juggernaut and Black Tom assault Muir Island, where Xavier is under Moira's care, and take Lilandra. The record names Muir Island but shows no place.

now.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
now.text: In episode 57, Moira runs her lab on Muir Island and asks the X-Men to help her son, Proteus.

changes.evidence: Proteus Part I (ep 56): Moira is trying to help her son Kevin at Muir Island and calls on the X-Men when he escapes from it. The record names Muir Island but shows no place.

now.title: X-Men '97
now.text: In episode 5, Moira sits on Genosha's council and dies in the Sentinel attack.

changes.evidence: Remember It (X-Men '97 ep 5): Moira, elected to Genosha's council, is killed in the Sentinel attack on Genosha (Marvel Database, Moira MacTaggert (Earth-92131)). The record names Genosha but shows no place.

now.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
now.text: In episode 53, Gambit, Rogue, and Wolverine protect Nightcrawler, a monk in a mountain abbey, from a fearful mob.

changes.evidence: Nightcrawler (ep 53): Gambit, Rogue and Wolverine are on a ski trip in Germany and find Nightcrawler in the local monastery the townsfolk attack. Gambit's and Rogue's records for the same episode already show The Bavarian Alps; this one shows no place.

now.title: X-Men '97
now.text: In episode 10, Kurt joins the X-Men after Genosha and is stranded with them in ancient Egypt.

changes.evidence: Tolerance Is Extinction Part 3 (ep 10): Bishop says Rogue, Nightcrawler, Beast, Xavier and Magneto are in Ancient Egypt in 3000 B.C. The record names ancient Egypt but shows no place.

now.title: X-Men '97
now.text: In episode 17, back home, he defends his half-brother Graydon Creed and beats Exodus in a sword duel.

changes.evidence: Strange Land, Savage Heart (ep 17): the trial of Creed and Nightcrawler's sword duel with Exodus happen at the Acolytes' Savage Land base; Colossus's record for the same event names the Savage Land. This one shows no place.

now.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
now.text: In episode 26, powerless in the Savage Land with Magneto, he is captured by Sinister and freed by the X-Men.

changes.evidence: Whatever It Takes to Reunion (eps 16-26): Xavier and Magneto lose their powers in the Savage Land, where Sinister captures them and the X-Men free them. The record names the Savage Land but shows no place.

now.title: X-Men '97
now.text: In episode 10, Xavier stops Magneto's blackout before Asteroid M's explosion throws him into ancient Egypt.

changes.evidence: Tolerance Is Extinction Part 2-3 (eps 9-10): on Asteroid M Xavier takes control of Magneto and restores power to Earth before the asteroid explodes. The record's event is on Asteroid M but shows no place.

now.title: X-Men '97
now.text: In episode 14, he watches Apocalypse kill Magneto and is rescued by Bishop.

changes.evidence: Rise of Apocalypse Part II (ep 14) is set in Ancient Egypt in 3000 B.C.; Apocalypse kills Magneto in front of Xavier, who is later rescued by Bishop. The event is in Egypt but shows no place.

now.title: X-Men '97
now.text: In episode 8, presumed dead at Genosha, Magneto is really Bastion's prisoner until Valerie Cooper sets him free.

changes.evidence: The record's event is Magneto held as Bastion's prisoner and freed by Valerie Cooper (Bright Eyes ep 7 reveal; Tolerance Is Extinction Part 1, ep 8: 'A horrified Cooper releases Magneto'), which is the OZT story. The Genosha Massacre case (ep 5) is only alluded to ('presumed dead at Genosha'), not described, so it does not match this record.
